    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeDocument.products.itemByProductType("DesignProductType"))
    root = des.rootComponent
    b = root.bRepBodies.item(0)
    print("faces:", b.faces.count)
    for i, f in enumerate(b.faces):
        g = f.geometry
        t = type(g).__name__
        bb = f.boundingBox
        info = ""
        if t == "Plane":
            info = "n=%s" % ([round(v,3) for v in g.normal.asArray()],)
        elif t == "Cylinder":
            info = "r=%.3f axis=%s" % (g.radius*10, [round(v,3) for v in g.axis.asArray()])
        print(i, t, "area=%.1f"%(f.area*100), [round(v*10,2) for v in bb.minPoint.asArray()], [round(v*10,2) for v in bb.maxPoint.asArray()], info)
    return None
